title: A Busy Saturday
text: On Saturday, I wake up early in the morning. At seven o'clock, I eat breakfast. In the afternoon, I do my homework for one hour. Then I play with my friends until evening. At night, I read a book with my family. I always go to bed before midnight, but sometimes I stay up a little later!

questions.question: What time does the child eat breakfast?
questions.source_sentence: At seven o'clock, I eat breakfast.

questions.question: When does the child play with friends?
questions.source_sentence: Then I play with my friends until evening.

questions.question: When does the child always go to bed?
questions.source_sentence: I always go to bed before midnight, but sometimes I stay up a little later!
